'''Nicolae Filip''' (3 March 1926 &ndash; 15 May 2009) was a [[Moldova]]n physicist born in the village of [[Drochia District|Sofia]], [[Bălți County (Romania)|Bălți County]] to a family of farmers. He contributed significantly to the study of "The spread of ultrashort radio waves" and was elected as an honorary member of the [[Academy of Sciences of Moldova]].<ref>[http://www.asm.md/?go=detalii-membri&n=132&new_language=0] Detalii despre membrii Academiei de Ştiințe a Moldovei</ref>

He was the Chancellor of [[Bălți]]'s [[Alecu Russo State University of Bălți|State University "Alecu Russo"]].

==Biography==
Nicolae Filip was born on 3 March 1926, in [[Sofia, Drochia|Sofia]] Village of [[Bălți County (Romania)|Bălți County]], in a family of peasants. He completed the primary 7 years school at his native village, and then, the middle school No. 1 in the Bălți town.

In 1948, he became a student of the Faculty of Physics and Mathematics of the [[Moldova State University|State University]], [[Chișinău]]. After the third year of education, he was transferred to the Pedagogical Institute of Chișinău and in 1952graduated it with the honorable mention, obtaining the diploma of [[physicist]]. In the same year, he became a lecturer at the [[Soroca]] Institute of Education.

Since 1953, he has been working at the Pedagogical Institute in [[Bălți]] and, after its reorganization into the [[Alecu Russo State University of Bălți|"A. Russo” State University]], he occupied the positions of lecturer, senior lecturer, professor, associate professor, head of the department, deputy-rector for science, rector.

== Career ==
* Doctor of Physical and Mathematical Sciences (1962). 
* Habilitirovanny Doctor of Physical and Mathematical Sciences (1979). 
* University Professor (1980), a leading specialist in the field of radio physics. 
* Excellence in Public Education of the USSR (1971). 
* 1973 awarded the title "Honored Worker of Higher School of MSSR. 
* 1995 was elected an honorary member of the Academy of Sciences of Moldova. 
* 1996 awarded the State Prize of the Republic of Moldova in the field of science and technology. 
* Since 1997, ND Philippe member of the International Academy of Sciences Graduate School. 
* 2000 [[Honorary Doctor]] Jassy Technical University. Gh.Asachi. 
* Since 2001, is an honorary citizen of the city [[Bălți|Belts]].

== Awards ==
* Order "[[Order of Work Merit (Moldova)|Order of Work Merit]]", 1995
* Order "[[Order of the Republic (Moldova)|Order of the Republic]]", 2001

[[Bălți]] Municipal Council Decision Nr. 11/24 on 03.04.2001, the recorded in the Book of Honor by assigning him the title "Honorary Citizen mun. Bălți."
